meta.title: FAVX
meta.description: A platform to share recommendations, experiences and moments.

landing.headline: Share recommendations, experiences and moments.
landing.sub: A place to keep what you recommend and help other people find what matters.

login.title: Sign in to FAVX
login.intro: We will email you a verification code. No password needed.

errors.otp_invalid: The code must be 6 to 10 digits.
errors.otp_failed: Invalid or expired code. Request a new one.
errors.send_failed: We could not send the code right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.username_format: Use 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter or number.
errors.display_name_too_long: The display name can have at most 80 characters.
errors.bio_too_long: The bio can have at most 500 characters.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
